<description>
I think it is clear that devs are not following the clang-format config here even in new code, and I don't want to rub this in during review, nor do I want to see clang-format edit those when I use it locally.

So relax the config to allow those.

References:

https://clang.llvm.org/docs/ClangFormatStyleOptions.html#allowshortloopsonasingleline:

```
git grep --line-number --perl-regexp '^\s*for \([^)]+\) [^{]+;$' ./src/ | wc -l
-> 111
```

https://clang.llvm.org/docs/ClangFormatStyleOptions.html#alwaysbreaktemplatedeclarations:

```
git grep --line-number --perl-regexp '^\s*template\s*<.*>\s*(?:class|struct|[A-Za-z_])' | wc -l
-> 162
```
</description>

<commits>
fa90a74455 doc: clang-format: AllowShortLoopsOnASingleLine: true

fa07938a6f doc: clang-format: AlwaysBreakTemplateDeclarations: No
</commits>

<files>
src/.clang-format  +2/-2

(test/bench/ci lines: 0)
</files>

<patch>
diff --git a/src/.clang-format b/src/.clang-format
index 4a34c68bf2..52d7ff897e 100644
--- a/src/.clang-format
+++ b/src/.clang-format
@@ -39,11 +39,11 @@ AllowShortEnumsOnASingleLine: true
 AllowShortFunctionsOnASingleLine: All
 AllowShortIfStatementsOnASingleLine: WithoutElse
 AllowShortLambdasOnASingleLine: All
-AllowShortLoopsOnASingleLine: false
+AllowShortLoopsOnASingleLine: true
 AlwaysBreakAfterDefinitionReturnType: None
 AlwaysBreakAfterReturnType: None
 AlwaysBreakBeforeMultilineStrings: false
-AlwaysBreakTemplateDeclarations: Yes
+AlwaysBreakTemplateDeclarations: No
 AttributeMacros:
   - __capability
 BinPackArguments: true

</patch>
(Diff from merge base to head, smallest files first.)
